units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: г) unpaid membership of a collegiate body of a commercial or nonprofit organization on the basis of an act of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: д) unpaid representation of the interests of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or a federal territory in the management bodies and audit commission of an organization whose founder (shareholder, participant) is the Russian Federation, a constituent entity or a federal territory, in accordance with normative legal acts of the Government of the Russian Federation, of a constituent entity or of public authorities of a federal territory establishing the procedure for exercising the powers of an organization's founder on behalf of the Russian Federation, a constituent entity or a federal territory, or for managing shares (interests in charter capital) in federal ownership, ownership of a constituent entity or municipal ownership of a federal territory; or in accordance with normative legal acts of public authorities of a federal territory establishing the procedure for managing federally owned shares (interests in charter capital) in respect of which those public authorities exercise the owner's powers;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: е) other cases provided for by international treaties of the Russian Federation or federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint «е» Point 3 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 3.1) engaging in entrepreneurial activity personally or through trusted persons;
units.label: Point 3.1 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 4) acquiring income-generating securities in cases established by federal law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 5) acting as an attorney or representative in third parties' matters before the state body in which the civil servant holds a civil service position, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law or other federal laws;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 6) receiving rewards from individuals or legal entities in connection with the performance of official duties (gifts, monetary rewards, loans, services, payment for entertainment, holidays or transport costs, and other rewards). Gifts received by a civil servant in connection with protocol events, official business trips and other official events are recognized as federal property or property of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, as appropriate, and are transferred by the civil servant under a transfer record to the state body in which they hold a civil service position, except in cases established by the Civil Code of the Russian Federation. A civil servant who has handed over a gift received in connection with a protocol event, official business trip or other official event may purchase it in the manner established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 7) travelling outside the territory of the Russian Federation in connection with the performance of official duties at the expense of individuals or legal entities, except official business trips made in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation under agreements between state bodies of the Russian Federation, state bodies of its constituent entities or municipal bodies and state or municipal bodies of foreign States or international or foreign organizations;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 8) using material, technical and other support resources or other state property for purposes unrelated to official duties, or transferring them to other persons;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 9) disclosing or using for purposes unrelated to civil service information classified as confidential under federal law, or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 10) making public statements, judgments or assessments, including through the mass media, concerning the activities of state bodies and their heads, including decisions of a superior state body or the state body in which the civil servant holds a civil service position, unless this forms part of the civil servant's official duties;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 11) accepting, without written permission from the employer's representative, awards or honorary and special titles (except academic titles) from foreign States, international organizations, political parties, other public associations or religious associations, if the civil servant's official duties include interaction with those organizations and associations;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 12) using the advantages of official position for election campaigning or campaigning on referendum issues;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 13) using official powers in the interests of political parties, other public associations, religious associations or other organizations, or publicly expressing an attitude towards them in the capacity of a civil servant, unless this forms part of official duties;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 14) establishing within state bodies structures of political parties, other public associations (except trade unions, veterans' bodies and other bodies of public initiative) or religious associations, or assisting their establishment;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 15) ceasing to perform official duties for the purpose of settling a service dispute;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 16) membership of management bodies, boards of trustees or supervisory boards, or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations and their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 17) engaging, without written permission from the employer's representative, in paid activity financed exclusively by foreign States, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 17 Part 1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 1.1. A civil servant, their spouse and minor children are prohibited from opening or holding accounts (deposits), keeping cash and valuables in foreign banks located outside the territory of the Russian Federation, or owning and/or using foreign financial instruments in the cases provided for by the Federal Law ‘On Prohibiting Certain Categories of Persons from Opening and Holding Accounts (Deposits), Keeping Cash and Valuables in Foreign Banks Located outside the Territory of the Russian Federation, and Owning and/or Using Foreign Financial Instruments’. The term ‘foreign financial instruments’ is used in this Federal Law in the meaning defined by that Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 2. If a civil servant's ownership of securities (participating interests or shares in organizations' charter or pooled capital) causes or may cause a conflict of interest, the civil servant must transfer those securities (participating interests or shares in organizations' charter or pooled capital) into trust management in accordance with the civil legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 3. After dismissal from the civil service, a citizen may not disclose or use in the interests of organizations or individuals confidential or official information learned in connection with the performance of official duties.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 3.1. A citizen who held a civil service position included in a list established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation may not, for two years after dismissal from the civil service, without the consent of the relevant commission on compliance with civil servants' official conduct requirements and resolution of conflicts of interest, hold positions in an organization under an employment contract and/or perform work for or provide services to that organization under a civil-law contract or contracts, in the cases provided for by federal laws, if certain state-administration functions concerning that organization formed part of the civil servant's official (service) duties. The commission's consent is given in the manner established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation. Its consent is not required where the citizen is appointed to that organization by decision of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 17. Prohibitions connected with the civil service
units.text: 4. Liability for failure to comply with the prohibitions in this Article is established by this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 17

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.label: Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 1. A civil servant is obliged to:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 1) perform official duties conscientiously and to a high professional standard;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 2) proceed from the principle that recognition, observance and protection of human and civil rights and freedoms determine the meaning and content of their professional service activity;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 3) carry out professional service activity within the state body's competence established by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 4) ensure equal and impartial treatment of all individuals and legal entities, give no preference to any public or religious association, professional or social group, citizen or organization, and avoid bias towards such associations, groups, citizens and organizations;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 5) refrain from actions influenced by any personal, property-related (financial) or other interests that obstruct conscientious performance of official duties;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 6) observe the restrictions established for civil servants by this Federal Law and other federal laws;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 7) maintain neutrality, excluding the possibility that decisions of political parties, other public associations, religious associations or other organizations influence their professional service activity;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 8) refrain from acts disgracing their honour and dignity;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 9) be courteous in dealings with citizens;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 10) respect the moral customs and traditions of the peoples of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 11) take account of the cultural and other characteristics of different ethnic and social groups and religious denominations;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 12) promote interethnic and interfaith concord;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 13) avoid conflict situations capable of damaging their reputation or the state body's authority;
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 14) observe the established rules for public speaking and provision of official information.
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 18. Requirements for a civil servant's official conduct
units.text: 2. A civil servant holding a position in the ‘managers’ category must prevent civil servants from being compelled to participate in the activities of political parties, other public associations or religious associations.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 18

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.label: Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 1. For the purposes of this Federal Law, ‘conflict of interest’ has the meaning established by part 1 of Article 10 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 2. The emergence of a civil servant's personal interest that causes or may cause a conflict of interest is prevented to avoid harm to the lawful interests of citizens, organizations, society, a constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 3. For the purposes of this Federal Law, ‘personal interest’ has the meaning established by part 2 of Article 10 of Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 3.1. Prevention or resolution of a conflict of interest may consist in changing the official or service position of the civil servant who is a party to it, up to suspension from official (service) duties in the prescribed manner, and/or relinquishment by that civil servant of the benefit that caused the conflict of interest.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 3.2. Failure by a civil servant who is a party to a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3.2 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 4. An employer's representative who learns that a civil servant has a personal interest causing or potentially causing a conflict of interest must take measures to prevent or resolve it, up to suspending the civil servant who is a party to the conflict from the civil service position held in the manner established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 4.1. Failure by a civil servant acting as an employer's representative who has learned that a subordinate civil servant has a personal interest causing or potentially causing a conflict of interest to take measures to prevent or resolve it is an offence entailing dismissal of the civil servant acting as the employer's representative from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 4.1 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 5. To ensure compliance with civil servants' official conduct requirements and resolve conflicts of interest, commissions on compliance with civil servants' official conduct requirements and resolution of conflicts of interest (hereinafter conflict-of-interest commissions) are established in state bodies, the federal state body responsible for managing state service and the state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation responsible for managing state service (hereinafter a state service management body).
units.label: Part 5 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 6. A conflict-of-interest commission is established by a legal act of a state body in the manner determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 7. Conflict-of-interest commissions are formed so as to exclude the possibility of conflicts of interest that could influence their decisions.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 19. Resolution of conflicts of interest in the civil service
units.text: 8. Regulations on commissions on compliance with federal state servants' official conduct requirements and resolution of conflicts of interest are approved in the manner determined by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 19

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.label: Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 1. In the cases established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’, the information on income, property and property-related obligations required by that Federal Law is submitted to the employer's representative by:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 1) a citizen seeking a civil service position;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 2) a civil servant.
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 1.1. Repealed from 1 January 2026. — Federal Law No. 505-ФЗ of 28.12.2025.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 2. Regulations on submission, in accordance with this Article, of information on income, property and property-related obligations by a civil servant holding a civil service position included in a list established by normative legal acts of the Russian Federation are approved, respectively, by an act of the President of the Russian Federation or a normative legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, taking account of this Article's requirements.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 3. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article is confidential unless classified as a state secret by federal law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 4. Information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article may not be used to establish or determine the solvency of the civil servant, their spouse or minor children, or to collect donations (contributions), directly or indirectly, for the funds of public or religious associations or other organizations, or for individuals.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 5. Persons guilty of disclosing information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article, or of using it for purposes not provided for by federal laws, bear liability under this Federal Law and other federal laws.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 6. The accuracy and completeness of information on income, property and property-related obligations submitted under this Article are verified in the manner established by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ and other normative legal acts of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 6.1. A civil servant's failure to submit the information on income, property and property-related obligations required by Federal Law No. 273-ФЗ of 25 December 2008 ‘On Combating Corruption’ where submission is mandatory, or submission of knowingly incomplete information, is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service, except in cases established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 20

units.locator: Article 20. Submission of information on income, property and property-related obligations
units.text: 6.2. A civil servant's submission of knowingly inaccurate information referred to in part 6.1 of this Article is an offence entailing dismissal from the civil service.
units.label: Part 6.2 Art. 20
